+    def _class_info(self, node: nodes.ClassDef) -> Any:
+        """Return the analysis info for a class node.

+            return node
+        return self.linker.module_info[node]

+    @staticmethod
+    def _ensure_legacy_attrs(
+        node: nodes.NodeNG, attrs: tuple[tuple[str, Callable[[], object]], ...]
+    ) -> None:
+        """Initialize the pre-refactor analysis attributes on a node.
+
+        Before the dataclass refactoring the analysis data was stored directly
+        on the astroid nodes. Keep this behaviour working when a diagram is
+        created without an explicit linker (e.g. by third-party code).
+        """
+        for attr, factory in attrs:
+            if not hasattr(node, attr):
+                setattr(node, attr, factory())
